about: Rugby League > Socks (rugby-socks-textured.glb, MODELQ6 2026-11-18; shape only: its painted colours and its own UVs are not used): coloured from the same pair split into parts by Tripo (rugby-socks-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: each sock's folded top band the Collar colour (else the Secondary: the look's navy), one plain colour, its foot one smooth line round the leg; the leg and foot the print (navy, our yellow 3 on the shin: sockprint.js). Its inside the cloth's own colour in shade and no bright edge light on it (data insideCloth, matte: main.js). Stitch lines: one round the leg just under the top band's foot, one on the band under its top fold.
